newsitem.title: USA: US Midco Group unleaded, diesel basis seen easing.
newsitem.headline: US Midco Group unleaded, diesel basis seen easing.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel basis eased on Monday in Group Three, where plentiful stocks were expected to push differentials lower this week, traders said.

The Williams pipeline system said it would not allow overrides in the current cycle because the system was nearing capacity on high sulphur diesel and premium unleaded grades in the Midwest, traders said.
"The system is full, and storage is full," one trader said.

The blast of arctic weather sweeping the Midwest was expected to dampen unleaded differentials due to a seasonal drop in automobile travel. But some traders saw heating oil demand rising as consumers called to refill their tanks mid-winter, pushing wholesalers back into the spot market.
"(Consumers) have consumed all they have at home, and jobbers will be making the rounds again in the next couple of weeks," one Chicago-area trader said.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was bid 5.50 cents a gallon under NYMEX February heating oil, with high sulphur basis 8.75 cents under the print.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was talked 5.25/5.0 cents a gallon under the print, with high sulphur 6.0 cents under, traders said.
